id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the card list.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

orientation.description: Orientation of Card List either vertical or horizontal. Defaults to Horizontal.

primaryActionButton.description: The configurations for the optional first action button at the bottom of each card.

secondaryActionButton.description: The configurations for the optional second action button at the bottom of each card.

containerHeaderLink.description: The configurations for the link to be used for the `See All` text.

containerHeaderText.description: The text that will be shown in the header of the list container.

infoTooltipText.description:
The tooltip text for the info icon.
It accepts a string or a `UiSdlDynamicValueSpec` object.

containerSubtitleText.description: The text that will be shown as the subtitle of the list container.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the cardlist has no data.

dataCollection.description: Holds the data to display in the card list.

title: Custom {@link UiSdlCardList} wrapper used to apply custom css styling to components.
name: UiSdlCustomCardList
